retention: All failed captured gates and exploratory logs remain; successful successors do not replace their bytes.

findings.finding: A real HTTP TaskRun state call lacked execution headers because it used the legacy direct HTTPX path.
findings.resolution: Attach and scope authority in both lower HTTPX clients, including redirects; real HTTP tests cover legacy state calls and cross-origin privacy.

findings.finding: Early protocol tests used deprecated instance model_fields and a nested EOF binding unsupported by the actual client signature.
findings.resolution: Correct test invocation, retain failed reports; no server behavior inferred from these harness errors.

findings.finding: Source-child control incorrectly awaited an already synchronous EventsWorker.drain_all().
findings.resolution: Use its synchronous interface; signed sync/async source process controls rerun.

findings.finding: CI type analysis found an unnecessary runtime isinstance guard and an untyped dict default factory.
findings.resolution: Accept object at signature validation boundary and use a typed dictionary factory; final analysis has zero errors and baseline139 warnings.

findings.finding: Signed events could change immutable task tags affecting concurrency policy.
findings.resolution: Compare normalized string-list tags to immutable manifest under recorder locks; signed PostgreSQL negative proves no TaskRun/State mutation.

findings.finding: All-or-none SQL witness CHECKs accepted near-complete NULL shapes through SQL three-valued logic.
findings.resolution: Require every nullable second-branch witness explicitly non-NULL in ORM and both paired migrations; real two-dialect adversarial cases added.

findings.finding: Simultaneous xdist/process-pool, UI hooks and native HTTP gates exceeded hosted API readiness and the existing0.5s ProcessPool nonblocking threshold.
findings.resolution: Keep thresholds unchanged; repeat gates sequentially. Initial native196pass1readinesserror and kernel717pass1timingfailure remain rejected.

findings.finding: Review corrections changed source bytes during earlier frozen gates.
findings.resolution: Source-bound verdicts remain FAIL; final profiles must share the post-tags/post-CHECK53-file manifest.

findings.finding: The first manual UI checker targeted an intentionally ignored generated API file and processed zero files.
findings.resolution: Retain failed invocation; successful successor checks the full UI read-only, then lint/build and323API tests sequentially.

findings.finding: Kernel-closure assertions all passed, but an auxiliary Uvicorn startup inherited the unsuffixed test base and logged InvalidCatalogNameError.
findings.resolution: Do not accept that log as clean closure. Create the owned isolated base, run the real Prefect database upgrade, then rerun the identical kernel profile without changing the53source files. Other nine selected profiles have no matching startup/catalog/connection/crash anomaly.
